name: prompt-806
image_purpose: cultural fashion lookbook and editorial portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a 4K hyper-detailed cinematic fashion portrait of an adult East Asian woman in Tang-inspired ceremonial styling against a snowy dark background.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman using the required approved-adult face reference, with consistent facial features, hair styling, and identity across the image. She wears an elegant Tang-inspired qixiong ruqun ensemble with red and gold embroidery, translucent wide sleeves, flowing pibo ribbons, an ornate high bun with peony hair ornaments and gold hair jewelry, and holds a red embroidered round fan.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium shot looking back over the shoulder, eye-level, center-right subject placement, flowing orange and teal ribbons sweeping through the frame, falling snow, dark background, subtle cold breath and warm floating particles.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft facial spotlight with warm rim light, moody dark atmosphere, cinematic glow on silk, lace, jewelry, snow particles, and moving ribbons.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm lens, f/1.8 shallow depth of field, low-key exposure with face highlight, high contrast, professional 4K/8K-style detail, natural fabric flow and frozen snow motion.
